wall.note: Shuffled wall of 136 tiles. Server deals 13 to each player, then draw one at a time.

dead_wall.note: 14 tiles reserved from the wall: 4 dora indicators (public) and replacement draws for kan.

hand.note: Player's concealed hand tiles. 13 tiles between turns, 14 after drawing.

discard.note: Player's discard river in order of play. Claimed tiles are marked.

melds.note: Open melds (chi, pon, open kan) are public. Concealed kan also stored here but face down.

dora_indicators.note: Revealed dora indicator tiles from the dead wall. Initially 1; additional revealed per kan.

riichi_pool.note: Unclaimed riichi stick deposits (1000 points each) from previous draws.

tile.note: 136 tiles: 3 suits x 9 ranks x 4 copies (108) + 4 winds x 4 (16) + 3 dragons x 4 (12). Includes 3 red fives (akadora).

phases.name: deal
phases.note: Server shuffles wall, deals 13 tiles to each player, reserves 14 for dead wall, reveals first dora indicator.

phases.name: draw
phases.note: Active player draws the top tile from the wall into hand (now 14 tiles). Player may declare tsumo (self-draw win) or riichi before discarding.

phases.name: discard
phases.note: Active player discards one tile face up to their discard river.

phases.name: claim_window
phases.ends_when: all players have responded or timeout
phases.note: After a discard, all other players may claim: ron > pon/kan > chi > pass. Ron wins immediately. Pon/kan by any player. Chi only by the next player in turn order (shimocha).

phases.name: scoring
phases.note: Simplified scoring: count han from yaku patterns and fu from melds. Points transfer from losers to winner.

chi.definition: Claim discarded tile to complete a sequence (three consecutive tiles of the same suit)
constraints: claimant is shimocha (next player in turn order after discarder)
claimed tile plus two tiles from hand form a consecutive sequence in the same suited suit
suited suits only (characters, bamboo, dots) — not winds or dragons
chi.effect: move claimed tile + 2 from hand to melds as open chi; claimant must discard

pon.definition: Claim discarded tile to complete a triplet (three identical tiles)
constraints: claimant has two identical tiles in hand
pon.effect: move claimed tile + 2 from hand to melds as open pon; claimant must discard

kan.definition: Declare a quad of four identical tiles
constraints: open kan from discard: claimant has three identical tiles in hand
added kan: claimant has a pon meld and draws the fourth tile
concealed kan: claimant has four identical tiles in hand after drawing
kan.effect: move tiles to melds as kan; draw replacement from dead wall; reveal additional dora indicator

ron.definition: Win by claiming a discarded tile that completes a valid winning hand
constraints: claimed tile completes a valid winning hand (4 melds + 1 pair, or special pattern)
hand has at least one valid yaku
claimant has not previously passed on the same tile in this turn (furiten rule)

tsumo.definition: Win by self-drawing a tile that completes a valid winning hand
constraints: drawn tile completes a valid winning hand
hand has at least one valid yaku
tsumo.effect: game ends; all other players split payment to winner

riichi.definition: Declare riichi when tenpai (one tile from winning) with a concealed hand
constraints: hand is fully concealed (no open melds)
hand is tenpai (one tile away from a complete winning hand)
riichi.effect: deposit 1000 points to riichi_pool; hand is locked (auto-discard non-winning draws); grants ippatsu and riichi yaku

furiten.definition: A player in furiten cannot win by ron
furiten.constraint: if any of the player's winning tiles exists in their own discard river, they are furiten and cannot declare ron

claim_priority.definition: When multiple players claim the same discard, priority determines who wins
claim_priority.server_resolves: ron > pon/kan > chi; if multiple ron, closest to discarder wins (head bump)

library.winning_hand: hand.count + melds.count == 14 AND (4_melds_1_pair OR seven_pairs OR thirteen_orphans)
library.tenpai: exists tile T such that adding T to hand creates a winning_hand
library.dora_value: tile next in sequence after dora_indicator (9 wraps to 1, north wraps to east, white wraps to red)
library.han_count: sum of applicable yaku han values + dora count + uradora count (if riichi)

end_conditions.condition: tsumo declared with valid winning hand and yaku
end_conditions.name: tsumo

end_conditions.condition: ron declared with valid winning hand and yaku
end_conditions.name: ron

end_conditions.condition: wall.count == 0 and no player declares tsumo or ron
end_conditions.name: exhaustive_draw

end_conditions.condition: four_kan_abort or four_riichi_abort or four_wind_abort or nine_terminals_abort
end_conditions.name: abortive_draw

end_conditions.condition: after final round and player has highest score above 0
end_conditions.name: game_winner
